expect.asks_about: Which person in the photo is the user: the bearded man on the left or the short-haired blonde woman on the right?

item.title: Choose The Right Headshot Subject

turns.text: Can you make me a square professional headshot from this?

item.tests: Clarifies the intended person in a two-person source before producing a single identity-preserving headshot.

answer_sheet.Which person: I'm the woman with short blonde hair on the right.
answer_sheet.Style and expression: Natural and professional; keep my smile.
answer_sheet.Platform and size: No particular platform; square, 640 × 640 is fine.

must_haves: The only person in the final portrait is the short-haired blonde woman from the right of two-friends.jpg.
Her face, short blonde hairstyle and smile remain recognisable from the source.
The man is entirely absent, including any partial face, shoulder or arm.
The beach setting and casual presentation are replaced with professional clothing and an unobtrusive backdrop.
The output is a square head-and-shoulders portrait with natural-looking lighting and no visible editing artifacts.

turns.text: Could you make me a professional headshot from this pic? I've been meaning to get a proper headshot sorted out for a while. The thing I nearly forgot to mention in the middle of all this is that I'd like it to be square. I'm just a little nervous about how it'll turn out, since I don't usually know what makes a good headshot.

dialog.agent:
Absolutely—I’ll aim for a natural, polished square headshot with soft lighting and a simple background, while keeping you looking like yourself.

Which person are you: **the person on the left** or **the person on the right**?
dialog.user: I'm the woman with short blonde hair on the right. I'd like it to look natural and professional, and please keep my smile. Clothing and background are your call—I don't really know what works best for a headshot.

turns.agent:
I’m sorry—the headshot couldn’t be generated because your Magic Hour account has insufficient credits. No image was created.

The planned look is a **square head-and-shoulders portrait** with your smile and short blonde hair preserved, a simple navy blouse, soft lighting, and a neutral gray background. That’s a good choice for a natural, approachable professional headshot.

Once credits are available, we can try that edit using the photo you’ve already supplied.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Create a natural, photorealistic professional headshot of ONLY the adult woman with short blonde hair on the RIGHT in the reference photo. Preserve her recognizable facial identity, facial proportions, short blonde hairstyle, and her original warm, genuine toothy smile. Remove the man entirely. Square 1:1 composition, centered head and shoulders, camera at eye level, entire head visible with comfortable space above the hair. Dress her in a simple tasteful navy blue professional blouse with a modest neckline. Replace the beach with a softly blurred light warm-gray studio background. Use soft flattering daylight with natural skin texture and realistic coloring. Polished but approachable, minimal retouching, no excessive skin smoothing, no glamour makeover, no changes to facial structure, no text or logos.
